mass_definition: abs(native vertical G load in kN) * 1000 / 9.80665; entire modeled dead load; not an as-built bill of materials
selection_rule: For each response independently: percentage reduction relative to P36 / percentage extra total model mass relative to P36. P36 is undefined. Envelope of G, L_X_NEG, G_X_NEG. Not a safety or global optimum criterion.
